description.value: Lions Gate Community Recreation Centre is a modern municipal recreation facility operated by the North Vancouver Recreation & Culture Commission (NVRC) in the Lions Gate neighbourhood of the District of North Vancouver. It features a full gymnasium configurable for badminton, pickleball, volleyball, basketball, ball hockey, and futsal, along with rentable community rooms and a kitchen. Touring cyclists passing through North Vancouver's lower slopes may find it a convenient urban waypoint, though it is primarily a community facility rather than a destination attraction.

Because no positive evidence exists for most WWC criteria, those fields are left null per the rules.
